ladder.label: BOTTOMING
ladder.why: Buyers rejected the 2026-06-10 low (swing low printed) but price hasn't reclaimed its 10-day average — first box ticked, not all. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Confirmation = a close above the 10-day average with the average turning up. Daily momentum is ~75 bars from its bullish cross.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 52).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): bottoming. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Daily momentum ~75 bars from turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Setup almost complete — likely buy trigger in ~1–75 trading days if it closes back above its 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 形态接近完成——若收盘重新站上 10 日均线，预计将在约 1–75 个交易日内出现买入触发。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 52 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 52 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 11 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): StochRSI popped out of oversold. These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 买方拒绝了 2026-06-10 的低点（摆动低点已现），但价格尚未收复 10 日均线——第一项条件达成，并非全部。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 确认 = 收盘站上 10 日均线且均线开始向上。 日线动量距其看多交叉约 75 根 K 线。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 11 周 · 日线周期第 52 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。

ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。

ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid buy setting up (+46)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入构筑中（+46）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✓
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
